identity_key: Verified Entra tenant ID + object ID from trusted platform/OBO identity; never browser-supplied worker, facility or role headers
mappings: Security-admin-owned hc_ops.security.principal_scope bridge; synthetic Workday access_scope is test input and never directly grants cloud access. Missing/ambiguous/expired/revoked -> deny.
sql: OBO query identity for human SQL/Genie. Server-only tools use per-app SP through a broker that enforces the verified user's facility/domain/PHI scopes.
copy_controls: No automatic UC policy inheritance assumed. Only broker SP can query shared search; prefilter authorized facility/document ACL before retrieval plus verify each hit; apply Postgres RLS only to app-owned tables; internal synced tables remain read-only to broker only and require server-side verified facility predicates; cache key includes user/scope-version; session ownership checked every request; no raw PHI in logs. Security/control tables are separately restricted.
revocation: Re-evaluate scope on every operation; maximum stale authorization cache 60 seconds. Invalidate cached answers, copied text and active sessions on revocation; test direct bypass and old session/token paths.

roles.hcp-platform-admins: Audited administrator; break-glass for raw PHI
roles.hcp-data-engineers: Dev/test writes, protected prod reads; no runtime oracle
roles.hcp-data-scientists: Protected Silver; feature/ML dev/test writes; masked PHI
roles.hcp-clinical: Approved unmasked clinical Gold for assigned facilities, no Bronze
roles.hcp-finance: Masked finance/revenue domains for assigned facilities
roles.hcp-operations: Masked flow/workforce domains for assigned facilities
roles.hcp-auditors: Protected read-only audit/metadata views; masked PHI

resources.rollback: Never recreate/move; shared metastore ownership unchanged
Keyless pay-per-token, no silent model/SKU/processing geography switch
Operator controls privileged bootstrap; CI not Owner/UAA
Warehouse stop/start only; don't delete protected catalogs
Stop/pause/start through the same owner; per-app platform identity
Single versioned adapter; delete/rebuild indexes, preserve embeddings, restore ACLs
Autoscaling Postgres API; hard disable after pausing sync; exclude Beta bundle resource; preserve durable snapshots
Version configuration/access windows, exact supported budget scope
MLflow registry plus one serving adapter; no agents.deploy dual ownership
Custom FastAPI app; no separate agents.deploy owner
Phase 13 only; delete transport only after accepted archives and offsets reconciled; new source-instance ID on recreation
GitHub scheduled runner/local REST, durable ADLS ETag/lease state; never wake SQL to inspect sleep

retention.release: Pinned accepted package and frozen definitions for release lifetime
retention.recovery: Do not VACUUM/CDF/archive-delete beyond tested recovery point; retained snapshots/archives cover citations, not assumed default time travel.

rollback: Versioned contract impact review -> bounded test migration -> independent reconciliation -> access/cost/recovery checks -> new gate. Restore previous code/config and certified snapshot, or rebuild from pinned immutable native input; never edit accepted package. Failed migration blocks publication.
